vocab.title: Match each expression to its meaning
defs: doing what the rules and the law require
a rule written at headquarters for the whole group
the day when a rule starts to apply
the change that makes a global rule work in one country
to remember something important while you decide
a recommendation that helps you apply a rule
the process of putting something new into practice
the plan of who says what, to whom and when

items.situation: A manager asks: "Why did headquarters change this?"
tips: It changed so that the three countries have the same rule.
It comes into effect on the first of March.

items.situation: He asks: "And our agreement from last year?"
tips: We send a local adaptation in order to explain the agreement you already have.

items.situation: He asks: "What do I tell my team?"
tips: I pass the guideline on to you this week, so that you have the same words in front of you.

items.situation: He says the effective date is a holiday in his country.
tips: Thank you for pointing that out. I bear that in mind and I check it with compliance today.
point out = say what nobody noticed.

items.situation: He asks if the policy applies to everybody.
tips: It applies to all employees with a permanent contract.

listenings.text: Hello everyone, this is Claire, with the announcement about the remote work policy. First the date: the policy comes into effect on the first of March. Until then nothing changes, and we use February to prepare and to explain it. Second, the reason, because every manager will ask. We changed it so that the whole group has one rule. Today each entity decides alone, and when an employee moves from one company to another inside the group, we cannot explain the difference. Compliance asked us to close that. Third, what I need from you. Each region sends me the local adaptation by the tenth of February. Put in it anything that does not work in your country, with the reason. Not a long document, one page. Thank you.

Camila, hello, this is the operations manager in Buenos Aires. I read the new policy this morning, and I want to be honest with you. The three days in the office are not my problem. My problem is that last year we signed an agreement with the union for two days, and my team read the new policy before I did, because it was sent to everybody at the same time. So this morning I have fifteen people asking me a question I cannot answer. What I need from you is two things. First, please include our agreement in the local adaptation you send to headquarters. Second, tell me what I can say to my team this week, even if the answer is that we are still checking. Thank you. Call me when you can.
